integrity: The proof is reconstructed directly from the defining neighborhood inequalities. Exact executable checks cover all complete multipartite isomorphism types through order 13 at the support-optimization level and through order 7 by direct label enumeration. Novelty is stated on a best-of-knowledge basis relative to the cited and compared literature.
scientific_limitations: The theorem determines the minimum weight for connected complete multipartite graphs but does not classify or count all minimum functions, and it does not cover signed, unique-response, or generalized p-strong variants.
title: Exact total strong Roman domination of complete multipartite graphs
